reviews.comment: Very easy class to stay on top of! Super clear due dates and expectations. Replied to emails quickly and was always very kind and fair. Study for quizzes and tests with the textbook and you'll be golden.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I never saw or heard from this prof since I took the class online but this was one of the easiest classes I have ever taken. Literally took 10 minutes a week to complete. I would recommend this prof and the online class 100%
Professor Williams is amazing! This class was asynchronous and she had a clear outline of what was expected this semester! I enjoyed this class and would definitely take it again!

Took this class 100% asynchronous and took about 20 minutes a week (in exception to the 2 exams which took about 30 minutes each). No book required. Every assignment is pretty easy. Overall an extremely easy A. Would take another class with Dr. Williams in a heartbeat.

Dr. Williams sent out a PDF of the book at the beginning of the semester once the add/drop deadline passed. Midterm- open note, could use the online PDF version that she sent via email. Final- open note and proctored by Lockdown Browser, so you had to use a hard copy during the exam (could print PDF). Some problems on quizzes may show up on exams.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Super easy and simple class. 1 quiz a week and 2 exams throughout the semester. Book is not mandatory, but she does send out a PDF copy of it. Easy quizzes and exams as long as you keep up with the chapters.

Every week there was a textbook chapter to read along with a quiz. It never took more than an hour to complete. Lectures are an absolute waste of time but she kept them short and reduced them to once per week towards the end of the semester. Tests are open note with the same format as the quizzes. She also gave 5 bonus points at the end.

This class was fairly easy and considering it was asynchronous, I didn't come into contact with Dr. Williams very much. However, she basically just required us to take notes and a quiz every week. Most of the exams were open note and we had one simple final project. Definitely an easy A as long as you complete your assignments.

This class was pretty easy. Weekly quizzes based on the textbook. 2 exams the first one was open note/unproctored and the final was proctored/open note. 1 small project that is super easy to do. I only went to class the first week and I got a A in the class. Don't really even need to read the textbook. Sweet and caring professor.

Loved this class. Take notes and you will do very well in this class. 2 exams and weekly quizzes makes the course very manageable when taking other courses. Gave weekly reminders which was helpful to not miss deadlines.

It's an easy class mostly, 1 quiz every week and 2 exams. Exam 1 usually uses the questions from the quizzes and exam 2 is written by her. Exam 2 can be hard but not impossible to get a good grade on. She sends an email every week to remind the students about the quiz.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This class is very easy. The final was tougher than expected but otherwise, the workload was not bad at all. I definitely recommend everyone regardless of major to take this class. As long as you do the work, you're good to go.

2 exams, 1 lightening talk project, one 10 question quiz each week! super easy class and Professor Williams is so kind and makes sure to send the entire class an email each week reminding us of due dates and upcoming assignments. TAKE HER !!!!
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: EASY, weekly 10 question quizzes, 2 exams M/C and lightning talk where you submit a video/voice memo over one of the modules. Quizlet is a great resource !!!!

This class was super easy and is a good turbo booster for the GPA during ETAM. I think it's a CD requirement too. I took this class in the winter mini-mester so my quizzes were daily instead of weekly, but still took 10 mins. 2 tests and a project but very doable. Everything is open-note.

HLTH236 online is super doable. Weekly quizzes and a single project and 2 exams that aren't hard really. Williams is also helpful to contact via email and responds quickly. She's clear in what she expects for the class and will remind you of assignments that are due soon. Really nothing to worry about for her.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: easy class and she responds very quick to emails
